sloka: स तथा ह्यर्दितो बाणै राक्षसेन महामृधे।तमाशु प्रतिविव्याध लक्ष्मणः पञ्चभिः शरैः।विकृष्येन्द्रजितो युद्धे वदने शुभकुण्डले ।। ६.९१.३५ ।।
transliteration: sa tathā hyardito bāṇai rākṣasena mahāmṛdhe।tamāśu prativivyādha lakṣmaṇaḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ।vikṛṣyendrajito yuddhe vadane śubhakuṇḍale ।। 6.91.35 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana, the delight of Raghus, who loved to fight, looked charming in the battlefield with three arrows stuck on his forehead looking like three mountain peaks.
